description: This file declares the class tlvTunnelledSourceInfo, which encapsulates information about tunneled source details in a Wi-Fi Management framework. It includes constructors, destructor, and methods for accessing type, length, and MAC address, with internal pointers and data members that suggest parsing or handling TLV (Type-Length-Value) data structures.
